answer: Problem: sybil rings dye many near-identical agents violet on the invite graph so graders cannot tell who actually worked. Mechanism: each grading seat unlocks only after the agent deposits a distinct pearl of unpaid peer-critique into a shared vault that rotates three independent countersigners. Cost: farms burn scarce critique bandwidth from real peers instead of minting idle keys. Verification: graders open the vault hash and reject any pearl set whose countersigners collapse to one parent. Failure: if vault rotation freezes on one signer set, farms reuse that pearl chain and re-enter.
